select * from ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISSUE.ISSUE_EDATE >= TO_DATE(#{listingDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE >= TO_DATE(#{listingDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN '01' WHEN (ISSUE.ISSUE_EDATE < TO_DATE(#{listingDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE < TO_DATE(#{listingDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is null THEN '02' WHEN (ISSUE.ISSUE_EDATE < TO_DATE(#{listingDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE < TO_DATE(#{listingDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null THEN '03'
ELSE NULL END AS issueStage, PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS as issueStatus, PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodMarketId, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodAbbr, PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, PRODUCT.REGIST_ORG as registOrg, PRODUCT.ISSUER as issuer , PRODUCT.ISSUE_TYPE as issueType, ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS as issueClass, ISSUE.TENDER_TYPE as tenderType, ISSUE.TENDER_TARGET as tenderTarget, ISSUE.ISSUE_STYLE as issueStyle, round(ISSUE.PLAN_ISSUE_AMT/100000000,2) as planIssueAmt, case when ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS = '02' THEN ISSUE.ISSUE_SDATE else ISSUE.TENDER_SDATE end as issueDate, ISSUE.PAY_EDATE as payEdate, ISSUE.ASSIGN_REGDATE as assignRegdate, case when PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null then PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_DATE else PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE end as listingDate, case when PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null then PRODUCT2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID else PRODUCT_ADD.APPEAR_MARKET_ID end as appearMarketId, case when PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null then PRODUCT2.FINPROD_ABBR else PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR end as appearMarketAbbr, PRODUCT.VDATE as vdate, PRODUCT.MDATE as mdate, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_9 as type9, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_10 as type10, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_11 as type11, PRODUCT.COUPON_SPECIES as couponSpecies, PRODUCT.CCY as ccy, PRODUCT.ISSUE_PRICE as issuePrice, ISSUE.INT_TYPE as intType, ISSUE.PAY_CYCLE as payCycle, ISSUE.REFER_YIELD as referYield , round(ISSUE.MIN_PER_TAMT/100000000,2) as minPerTamt, round(ISSUE.MAX_PER_UTAMT/100000000,2) as maxPerUtamt, PRODUCT.REMARK as remark, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODUCT_ADD ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE ISSUE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ISSUE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID AND PRODUCT_TYPE.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO ON PRODUCT.ISSUER = CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT2 ON PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE = PRODUCT2.FINPROD_ID where PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET in (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02}) and PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS not in (#{ISSUE_STATUS_02}) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is null and PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE=#{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) t where t.issueStage=#{issueStage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
